$comment: Indian manufacturing-hub cities (lowercased) and the Hinglish/colloquial aliases that
resolve INTO that closed set. Lifted verbatim from apps/ai-service/app/pseudonymize.py,
which now reads this file.
THIS GAZETTEER IS FOR DETECTION, NOT MASKING (owner ruling 2026-07-31). The Master Context
DEAD LIST is authoritative: 'cities as PII (-> a 20-point matching input; never redact)'.
A worker's city is the single strongest matching signal this product has, and it is not
identity: 'Pune' identifies nobody. Masking it to [CITY_1] before the LLM cost the field on
every model-authored surface while protecting nothing.
An alias only ever normalizes to an EXISTING canonical member — it is not a loosening of
the closed set. `canonicalCity` / `_canonical_city` Title-case the result for display.
`states` TAGS EACH CANONICAL CITY WITH ITS STATE (#1429), so a client can offer a
state-then-city cascade instead of one flat list. Keyed by the canonical TOKEN; two tokens
(`bengaluru`, `gurgaon`) are also alias keys and fold onto another city, so the consumer
groups by the RESOLVED city and asserts the tokens for one city agree — see
worker-cities.catalogue.ts. Every value must be a member of states.json `administrative`.
TAGGING IS NOT WIDENING. No city is added here: `canonical` and `aliases` are unchanged, and
they are the carve-out in pseudonymize.py that stops a capitalised token being masked as a
person's name. Adding a CITY releases a string the gateway was withholding and is a privacy
decision; adding a state tag to a city already in the set is not.
#1560 WIDENS THE SET SO EVERY PICKABLE STATE HAS SUGGESTIONS. The work-history
employer-location picker filters this gazetteer by state, and 23 of the 36 administrative
states/UTs had zero cities — Andhra Pradesh selected, no suggestions, forced free text.
44 major cities and capitals are added (82 canonical tokens, 80 distinct cities) so each of
the 36 states/UTs has at least one suggestion; the cascade shape, the write contract and the
Flutter fallback are unchanged. Corpus re-run clean (548 rows); `gaya` deliberately omitted
(Hindi verb, 4 corpus collisions) and the R32(1) name-blocklist honoured (`daman`, `tirupati`
skipped — Bihar covered by Patna/Muzaffarpur, Andhra by Visakhapatnam/Vijayawada/Guntur, the
Dadra UT by Silvassa/Diu). New aliases: `pondicherry` (former name) and `vizag` (common short
form). See risks-register R32(1) for the privacy delta.
#1634 ADDS THREE CITIES FOR THE DESIGN2 HUB PICKER (owner ruling 2026-09-21): `kolhapur`,
`thane`, `sriperumbudur`, plus the alias `sriperambudur`. THE R32(1) DELTA, per city: none of
the three equals a common Indian given name. `Kolhapur` and `Sriperumbudur` are place-only
tokens; `Thane` is a surname, not a given name. The register's named collisions are
Salem/Anand/Daman/Tirupati/Vidisha/Rewa/Alwar/Ajmer/Karur — none of which is added here, and
Daman/Tirupati stay excluded. No test can catch a bad addition (the carve-out property test
only goes greener), so the argument lives here and in the risks register.

states.diu: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
states.silvassa: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
